acts.palette: weathered cream, hillstone gray, raincoat blue, warm brass, sun yellow, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical illustration of a windswept hilltop weather station, seen from above as a layered construction-paper diorama. Read the climb from a forked stone path at the bottom, past a canvas bag, loose cream observation sheets, glass gauges and a teal kite tangled in an antenna, to slatted instrument shelters and the station at the summit. Leave a broad, quiet middle corridor of pale hillstone for path lines. At the top, reserve a clear summit platform for the four-legged Unbroken Observer. Teal hexagonal growth gathers around the upper instruments. Visible paper grain, flat cut shapes, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no lettering, logos or real people.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 1–5: a windswept gray hill path with muted cream grasses, a low stone wall and distant blue hills; small gauge silhouettes and a few scattered teal hexagonal tiles sit at the edges. Keep the central playing area open and quiet. Layered construction paper, visible grain, flat colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins at movable joints and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 6–10: the same hill higher up, with pale slatted weather shelters, a folded yellow collector umbrella and faint blue kite shapes along the sides. Teal hexagonal growth clusters under the shelters and creeps across the ground, leaving a broad uncluttered center. Layered grainy construction paper, flat muted colors, cut edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 11–15: the station summit in muted gray and cream, with a shuttered clock housing and dark rain-gauge silhouette recessed at the edges. Dense teal hexagonal growth climbs the slatted walls and spreads in overlapping mats across the foreground, visibly consuming the station, while the center remains open and subdued for small creatures. Grainy layered cut paper, flat color, crisp edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.
acts.boss: Full-body imposing Unbroken Observer, centered and entirely visible: a tall tower assembled from stacked white slatted weather boxes, standing on four long splayed climbing legs with round brass pin joints. A huge black funnel-shaped rain gauge rises over its shoulder; several brass clock faces and a prominent shuttered clock sit in its torso. Strong angular silhouette against a simple muted blue-gray hill sky, a few teal hexagons clinging to its feet. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No numerals, readable text, logos or people.

acts.palette: laboratory cream, aircraft silver, slate gray, sensor orange, coil blue, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical illustration of an atmospheric research laboratory and aircraft workshop seen from above as a papercraft diorama. Journey upward from a paved probe yard with a white orange-finned probe and open case, through sensor tripods, diverging corridors, a calibration chamber and a yellow cutting gantry, then along cables to a large receiver assembly at the top. Place the radar dish, parked aircraft and instrument crates at the sides; keep a broad pale open middle ground for readable path lines. Reserve a clear upper platform for the tracked End-to-End Observatory. Teal hexagonal growth spreads along cables toward the receiver. Visible construction-paper grain, flat colors, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no text, logos or real people.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 1–5: a quiet paved sensor yard in pale cream and slate, with distant thin tripods, small orange-finned probes and a parked aircraft wing at the edges. A few teal hexagonal tiles gather beside a cable. Keep the central area open and subdued. Layered construction paper, visible grain, flat muted color, crisp cut edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 6–10: a muted laboratory corridor with pale insulated chambers, blue coils and silver ducts receding along the sides, plus a yellow gantry cropped at one edge. Teal hexagonal growth runs along floor cables and begins to climb the chamber walls. Leave the center open and low contrast. Grainy layered cut paper, flat colors, crisp edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 11–15: the receiver workshop, with a faded aircraft fuselage, instrument crates and a dish silhouetted at the far sides. Dense teal hexagonal growth blankets cable bundles, creeps over the workshop walls and spreads across the floor; retain a clear subdued center for small creatures. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat muted colors, crisp cut edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no readable text or logos.
acts.boss: Full-body imposing End-to-End Observatory, entirely visible in a broad three-quarter composition: a long silver aircraft fuselage mounted across a heavy tracked workshop chassis, topped by a tilted circular radar dish. Multiple jointed crane and repair arms extend outward around open instrument crates and small orange-finned probes. Make the wide fuselage, dish and twin tracks a clear, powerful silhouette; teal hexagonal patches cling to the chassis. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pin joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting against a quiet slate laboratory background. No readable text, logos or people.

acts.palette: midnight blue, observatory white, stone gray, aged copper, starlight silver, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical illustration of a hilltop astronomical observatory complex seen from above as a layered papercraft diorama at night. Travel upward from stone paths and five small bronze ground sensors, past a manual brass telescope, a circular star board with simple raised dots, cable junctions and smaller domes, to the largest white dome at the top. Branching copper cables join the ground sensors to the domes; a sparse rotating star shines above the summit. Keep the middle ground open and pale enough for path lines, and reserve a clear upper platform for the All-Sky Observatory. Teal hexagonal growth thickens along the cables and around the summit. Visible construction-paper grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no readable text, logos or real people.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 1–5: a quiet stone observatory approach beneath a muted midnight-blue sky, with small bronze ground sensors, low walls and distant white domes placed near the sides. A few teal hexagonal tiles appear around a cable. Keep the middle open and subdued. Layered construction paper, visible grain, flat color, crisp edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 6–10: a stone terrace between dim white domes, with branching copper cables, a manual telescope and a scattering of silver star dots at the margins. Teal hexagonal growth follows the cables and climbs the dome bases. Preserve a broad quiet center for small creatures. Grainy layered cut paper, flat muted colors, crisp edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.

Wide, low-contrast fight background for floors 11–15: the largest dome's approach in subdued midnight blue and stone gray, its curved white walls receding to the sides. Dense teal hexagonal growth encrusts the dome base, engulfs cable junctions and spreads in broad overlapping mats across the foreground. Keep the center clear and low contrast. Visible construction-paper grain, layered flat color, crisp cut edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre light; no readable text or logos.
acts.boss: Full-body imposing All-Sky Observatory, entirely visible: a huge white hemispherical dome raised on a wide ring of long black sensor legs, with one large blue glass eye set into its front. Branching copper cables spread from its body like roots, anchored with brass pins; a few teal hexagonal growths climb its legs. Give the dome and radial legs a bold, unmistakable silhouette against a quiet midnight-blue sky with one small silver star. Layered construction paper, visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No readable text, logos or people.
